# hallpass_backup_target (Resource)

Scheduled, encrypted backups of HallPass to S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO and others). Installation-wide: declare it at most once. Each backup is a database snapshot, encrypted on the server with a key protected by the KEK, plus the recordings it refers to (already encrypted, uploaded once). Restoring needs the KEK, so keep it backed up separately. Destroying the resource stops backups and leaves the objects in the bucket. The secret access key is write-only in HallPass and kept in state. Import with `backup-target` (the secret is not imported; the next apply sends it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Hourly encrypted backups to an S3 bucket, keeping the newest 48 and one per day for 30 days.
resource "hallpass_backup_target" "s3" {
  endpoint          = "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com"
  region            = "eu-central-1"
  bucket            = "acme-hallpass-backups"
  prefix            = "hallpass/"
  access_key_id     = var.backup_access_key_id
  secret_access_key = var.backup_secret_access_key
}

# Cloudflare R2:
#   endpoint = "https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com"
#   region   = "auto"

variable "backup_access_key_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "backup_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID. The key needs list, read, write and delete below the prefix.
- `bucket` (String) Bucket name.
- `endpoint` (String) Service origin, e.g. `https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com` or `https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`. Changing the endpoint, bucket, prefix or `path_style` starts over in the new location; objects in the old one are left alone.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key. Sent only when it changes.

### Optional

- `allow_private_network` (Boolean) Allow an endpoint that resolves to a private, loopback or link-local address.
- `ca_bundle_pem` (String) Extra trust roots (PEM) for an endpoint with a private CA.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Run scheduled backups. When false the target is kept but paused.
- `interval` (String) Time between backups, `15m` to `168h` (default `1h`). A failed backup is retried within 15 minutes.
- `keep_daily_days` (Number) Also keep the newest backup of each of this many past days (default 30; 0 keeps only the newest).
- `keep_last` (Number) Newest successful backups to keep (default 48).
- `path_style` (Boolean) Address the bucket as `endpoint/bucket` (MinIO and some providers).
- `prefix` (String) Key prefix, empty or ending with a slash (e.g. `hallpass/`).
- `region` (String) Region (default `us-east-1`; `auto` for Cloudflare R2).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `backup-target`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The target is a singleton.
terraform import hallpass_backup_target.s3 backup-target
```
